name: Del Monte Canned Cut Green Beans (Ultra-Soft)
whyItWorks: Commercial canning pressure-cooks green beans until completely soft, breaking down the tough outer pod fibers into a tender, easily masticated side. Very low residue and well-tolerated on low-FODMAP and low-residue diets.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm on stovetop in their liquid, then drain. Season with a pinch of salt and a dab of butter or olive oil.
watchOuts: Look for no-salt-added varieties if monitoring blood pressure on corticosteroid therapy.
